review.summary: Mercedes lead the constructors with 666 points from 21 rounds, ahead of Ferrari. Andrea Kimi Antonelli top the drivers' championship at 402, well clear of teammate George Russell on 264. At Las Vegas, Antonelli finished fourth and Russell ninth.

review.summary: Marco Bezzecchi won the Grand Prix of Portugal for Aprilia Racing, joined on the podium by team-mate Jorge Martin second; Raul Fernandez of SuperFile Trackhouse finished third.
